recommendations.headline: Satisfaction is the single biggest conversion lever – win rate is 72% on calls where the customer feels satisfied vs only 10% when neutral and 2% when dissatisfied, yet 56% of all calls end neutral and 55% (1,096) stall as 'callback' with no firm next step.
behaviour: Price-shopping and comparison dominate: 380 calls tagged price_shopper and 216 comparing_quotes, but price is actually discussed in only 31% of calls (price_reaction not_discussed=1,379/69%).
Stock and price are the two biggest friction points, almost tied: stock_availability (343 objections, 17%) and price_high (334, 17%), together touching over a third of all calls.
Dealers drive volume (1,036 calls, 52%) and convert reasonably (33% win), but 'unknown' segment is large (509 calls, 26% of volume) and converts poorly (14% win) – a qualification gap.
Urgency is common (296 high, 1,194 medium) but overall order conversion is only 19%, showing urgent intent is not being converted fast enough.
Customers repeatedly ask for stock availability (387 mentions), fast delivery (362) and cutting/processing (211) – these are value needs, not just price needs.
satisfaction: Only 29% of calls are rated satisfied (574/1,992); 56% are neutral and 10% dissatisfied – satisfaction, not price, best predicts the sale (72% vs 10% vs 2% win rates).

69% of calls never even reach a price discussion (1,379 of 1,992); when price is discussed, negotiation is the norm (377 negotiating vs 81 too_high), suggesting most customers are open to talking price, not rejecting it outright.
Price_high objection actually converts better (21% win) than stock_availability (16%) or credit_terms (13%), indicating price is less of a deal-breaker than availability and credit issues.
competitor_cheaper has the lowest win rate of all objections (8%, 72 calls) – once a customer compares us unfavourably to a competitor, we rarely recover the sale.

conversion.title: Fix the follow-up gap
conversion.evidence: 358 calls had no fixed follow-up set and 1,096 calls (55%) are stuck in 'callback' status
conversion.action: Every call must end with a specific date/time follow-up logged in CRM; managers audit open callbacks daily.

conversion.title: Speed up and clarify answers
conversion.evidence: 356 calls flagged slow_or_unclear_answer; 215 calls had no quote sent at all
conversion.action: Give reps a standard, pre-approved rate card/template so quotes can be sent on WhatsApp within the same call or within 2 hours.

conversion.title: Qualify 'unknown' segment calls early
conversion.evidence: Unknown segment is 26% of calls but converts at only 14% vs 33% for dealers
conversion.action: Reps must capture customer type (dealer/fabricator/contractor/etc.) and project details in the first 2 minutes of every call.

conversion.title: Always offer an alternative when stock is short
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is the top objection (343 calls, 17%) with only 16% win rate; 149 calls had didnt_offer_alternative
conversion.action: Train reps to proactively offer alternate size/brand/grade or part-load/transit-stock options whenever the exact item is unavailable.

conversion.title: Build a competitor-rate response protocol
conversion.evidence: competitor_cheaper has the lowest win rate of any objection (8%, 72 calls)
conversion.action: Give reps a quick-escalation path to a manager for competitive situations, backed by a value script (certification, stock reliability, logistics) rather than silence.

conversion.title: Ask for the order explicitly
conversion.evidence: 134 calls didn't ask for the order even when interest was shown (173 interested calls vs only 374 orders)
conversion.action: Add a mandatory 'close' step/script line after every quote: confirm quantity, vehicle, and payment plan on the same call.

conversion.title: Resolve credit-term hesitation faster
conversion.evidence: credit_terms objection has the lowest win rate (13%, 75 calls) alongside stock_availability
conversion.action: Create a fast-track credit-approval process for established dealers so reps aren't stuck waiting on manager sign-off mid-call.

offers.title: Ready-to-size cutting/processing service
offers.why: cutting_processing is the 4th highest need (211 mentions) and features in several successful calls (custom cut sizes, coil cutting).

offers.title: Priority/fast-track dispatch for urgent orders
offers.why: 208 calls tagged urgent_buyer and fast_delivery is the 2nd highest need (362 mentions).

offers.title: Instant WhatsApp rate and stock updates
offers.for_whom: Dealers and repeat buyers doing daily price checks
offers.why: regular_updates need (250 mentions) and many successful calls closed via a quick WhatsApp quote.

offers.title: Documentation assurance package (test certificate + tags)
offers.why: test_certificate need (143) and many quality/MTC-related complaints and questions in the call logs.

offers.title: Consider a formal credit-period option for vetted dealers
offers.for_whom: Repeat dealers/bulk buyers needing working-capital flexibility
offers.why: needs_credit behaviour (90 calls) and credit_period need (63) with credit_terms objection converting at just 13%.

offers.title: Stock-availability alerts for key sizes/brands
offers.for_whom: Dealers who repeatedly ask about specific sizes (8mm/10mm TMT, Vizag stock)
offers.why: stock_availability is both the top need (387) and top objection (343).

loyalty.title: Consider a dedicated contact/account manager for repeat and bulk buyers
loyalty.how: Assign a named rep as single point of contact for the 181 repeat_buyer and 205 bulk_buyer accounts
loyalty.why: These segments show committed buying behaviour and deserve consistent service to retain them.

loyalty.title: Consider priority allocation during shortages for loyal dealers
loyalty.how: Reserve a portion of constrained stock for known repeat dealers before opening to new/unknown callers
loyalty.why: stock_availability is the top objection (343) and the top reason deals stall.

loyalty.title: Consider a referral recognition policy
loyalty.how: Formally match or honour referral-based rate expectations when a customer is referred by an existing client
loyalty.why: Referral mentions (14) include a complaint about rate mismatch with a referral's quote, risking goodwill.

loyalty.title: Consider a proactive daily/weekly update broadcast
loyalty.how: Send a scheduled WhatsApp broadcast of rates and stock to repeat customers rather than waiting for them to call
loyalty.why: regular_updates is a top-5 need (250 mentions) and many summaries show reps reacting late to rate queries.

loyalty.title: Consider fast-track order processing for established dealers
loyalty.how: Skip repeat KYC/document steps for verified repeat dealers; streamline PO-to-dispatch cycle
loyalty.why: Successful calls show quick PO-to-vehicle-dispatch cycles build trust and satisfaction.

loyalty.title: Consider recognising 'loyal_to_us' and long-term dealers explicitly
loyalty.how: Flag these accounts in CRM for special handling (e.g., first call-back priority, dedicated hotline)
loyalty.why: Only 10 calls currently tagged loyal_to_us – an untapped, high-value, low-cost retention opportunity.

non_price_benefits.title: Multi-brand stock flexibility
non_price_benefits.why: Calls reference stock split across JSW, NMDC, SAIL, Mahaveer, Apollo etc., letting us offer alternatives when one brand is short.

non_price_benefits.title: Custom cutting and processing capability
non_price_benefits.why: Several successful calls closed because we offered custom cut sizes/coil cutting (cutting_processing need, 211 mentions).

non_price_benefits.title: Documentation transparency (test certificates, tags, MTC)
non_price_benefits.why: 143 calls need test certificates and many questions concern tag/MTC accuracy – reliable paperwork is a differentiator.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast vehicle arrangement and same-day dispatch
non_price_benefits.why: Multiple won calls show same-day open-body vehicle arrangement and quick loading, directly addressing fast_delivery need (362 mentions).

non_price_benefits.title: Wide product and size range under one roof
non_price_benefits.why: Top products span plate, TMT, channel, angle, HR coil, beams, ISMB etc., reducing need for customers to multi-source.

non_price_benefits.title: Transparent all-in pricing (GST/transport clarified upfront)
non_price_benefits.why: Customers repeatedly ask 'is GST and transport included' – proactively stating this avoids surprises and builds trust.

top_questions.question: Can you send the (revised) price quote?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send the quote on WhatsApp within the call or within 2 hours with a clear validity date; don't let it become one of the 215 no-quote-sent misses.

top_questions.question: Is [size/grade/brand] in stock right now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock before answering; if unavailable, immediately offer an alternate size/brand or transit-stock option.

top_questions.question: Can you match a competitor's rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Don't go silent – acknowledge, explain our value (certification, reliability, service) and escalate quickly to a manager for a decision rather than losing the call outright.

top_questions.question: Will the vehicle/delivery arrive by the committed time?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific time window and proactively update if there's any delay, rather than waiting for the customer to chase.

top_questions.question: Can you provide the test certificate/MTC with correct tag details?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm certificate availability on the call and send a clear scanned copy promptly; double-check tag/printing accuracy before dispatch.

top_questions.question: Can you offer credit period/terms for this order?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain current credit policy clearly and route eligible, established dealers to a fast credit-evaluation process instead of leaving it undecided.

top_questions.question: Can you cut the material to a custom size?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm cutting/processing capability and give a realistic turnaround time on the call.

top_questions.question: What is the status of my earlier enquiry/order?
top_questions.answer_tip: Proactively update customers before they have to call back; set a specific callback date/time every time to avoid the no-follow-up gap.
